title: Se isso, então aquilo
goal: Aluno sai sabendo formar primeira conditional pra situações reais futuras possíveis.
connects_to: M22 (Conexões) — depois das condicionais, aprende conectores e adverbs of manner.
module_chunks: If it rains, I'll stay home.
If she comes, we'll have dinner.

units.title: Se chover, eu fico
units.real_life_context: Você fala sobre o que vai fazer dependendo do tempo, agenda, decisão.

grammar.sentence: If it _____, I'll stay home.
grammar.explanation: First conditional: "If + present simple, will + base". A parte do "if" usa PRESENTE: "If it rains".

grammar.sentence: If she comes, we _____ have dinner.
grammar.explanation: Após if + present, usa "will + base" na consequência. "We will have" / "we'll have".

grammar.sentence: I _____ call you if I have time.
grammar.explanation: "I'll call you" — consequência futura. Will + base.

grammar.sentence: If you _____ early, you'll see the sunrise.
grammar.explanation: "If + present simple" — verbo base com you. "If you wake up early".

grammar.sentence: If it _____ sunny, we'll go to the beach.
grammar.explanation: "If it IS sunny" — present simple na cláusula if.

grammar.sentence: If she _____, I'll call her back.
grammar.explanation: "If she calls" — 3ª pessoa + -s no present.

grammar.sentence: We _____ travel if we save money.
grammar.explanation: "We will travel" — will + base na consequência.

grammar.sentence: If it will rain, I'll stay.
grammar.explanation: "If" usa PRESENTE, não will. "If it rains", não "If it will rain". Will só na consequência.

grammar.sentence: If she comes, we have dinner.
grammar.answer: If she comes, we'll have dinner.
grammar.explanation: Consequência futura precisa de WILL. "We'll have dinner", não "we have".

grammar.passage: If it rains tomorrow, I'll stay home. If it's sunny, we'll go hiking. If she comes, we'll have lunch together.
grammar.question: What will the speaker do if it's sunny?
grammar.explanation: The text says "If it's sunny, we'll go hiking".

listening_speaking.text: If it rains, I'll stay home.

units.title: Se eu tiver tempo
units.real_life_context: Você condiciona ações suas a fatores como tempo, dinheiro, disposição.

grammar.sentence: If I _____ time, I'll exercise.
grammar.explanation: "If I have" — present simple na cláusula if. Sem will.

grammar.sentence: If I have money, I _____ travel.
grammar.explanation: Consequência: "will travel".

grammar.sentence: I'll buy a car if I _____ enough.
grammar.explanation: "If I save" — present simple com I.

grammar.sentence: If she _____ enough sleep, she'll feel great.
grammar.explanation: "If she gets" — present simple 3ª pessoa: get + s.

grammar.sentence: I'll cook if you _____.
grammar.explanation: "If you shop" — present simple com you.

grammar.sentence: If I _____ a chance, I'll try.
grammar.explanation: "If I get" — present simple com I.

grammar.sentence: She _____ help if I ask.
grammar.explanation: "She will help" — will + base.

grammar.sentence: If I will go, I'll call you.
grammar.answer: If I go, I'll call you.
grammar.explanation: "If I go" — present simple. Will só na segunda parte.

grammar.sentence: I will travel if I save.
grammar.explanation: Em fala, usa-se "I'll" mais que "I will" — som mais natural. Ambas corretas mas "I'll" é melhor em diálogo.

grammar.passage: If I have time tomorrow, I'll go to the gym. If I save enough, I'll buy a bike. If my friend calls, I'll go out with her.
grammar.question: What will the speaker buy if they save enough?
grammar.explanation: The text says "If I save enough, I'll buy a bike".

I'll buy a car if I save.

units.title: Se você quiser
units.grammar_focus: First conditional with "you" — invitations and promises
units.real_life_context: Você convida ou oferece algo dependendo da pessoa querer.

grammar.sentence: If you _____ help, I'll come.
grammar.explanation: "If you need" — present simple. Sem will.

grammar.sentence: I'll cook if you _____ hungry.
grammar.explanation: "If you are hungry" — present simple. Sem will.

grammar.sentence: If you _____ time, we'll chat.
grammar.explanation: "If you have" — present simple com you.

grammar.sentence: We _____ help if you ask.
grammar.explanation: "We will help" — consequência.

grammar.sentence: If you _____ tired, take a break.
grammar.explanation: "If you are tired" — uso de to be + adj.

grammar.sentence: I'll lend you my book if you _____ careful.
grammar.explanation: "If you are careful" — to be + adj.

grammar.sentence: We _____ go to the cinema if you want.
grammar.explanation: "We will go" — will + base. Ou "we'll go".

grammar.sentence: If you will need help, I'll come.
grammar.answer: If you need help, I'll come.
grammar.explanation: Cláusula if = present simple. "If you need", não "If you will need".

grammar.sentence: I help you if you ask.
grammar.answer: I'll help you if you ask.
grammar.explanation: Will + base na consequência. "I'll help" — will obrigatório.

grammar.passage: If you need help, I'll come. If you're hungry, I'll cook. If you have time, we'll chat. I'm here for you.
grammar.question: What will the speaker do if you're hungry?

units.title: A menos que
units.real_life_context: Você expressa condições negativas com "unless" em vez de "if not".

grammar.sentence: I'll go _____ it rains.
grammar.explanation: "Unless" = "if not" / "a menos que". "I'll go unless it rains" = irei a menos que chova.

grammar.sentence: She'll come _____ she's busy.
grammar.explanation: "Unless she's busy" = se ela não estiver ocupada.

grammar.sentence: We'll leave _____ you want to stay.
grammar.explanation: "Unless you want to stay" = "if you don't want".

grammar.sentence: I _____ call you unless you ask me not to.
grammar.explanation: Consequência com unless: usa will + base.

grammar.sentence: I'll meet you _____ you're late.
grammar.hint: A menos que (a alternativa de "if not")
grammar.explanation: "Unless you're late" = se você não estiver atrasado.

grammar.sentence: She _____ come unless she's sick.
grammar.explanation: "She will come unless..." — will + base.

grammar.sentence: Unless _____ rains, we'll go to the park.
grammar.explanation: "Unless it rains" — sujeito "it" pra clima.

grammar.sentence: I'll go unless it doesn't rain.
grammar.explanation: "Unless" já tem sentido negativo (=if not). NÃO usar "unless + not" — é dupla negativa.

grammar.sentence: I'll go if not it rains.
grammar.explanation: "If not" em uma frase é comum, mas "unless" é mais natural pra essa construção.

grammar.passage: I'll come to the party unless I'm tired. We'll go hiking unless it rains. I'll cook dinner unless you want pizza.
grammar.question: When won't the speaker come to the party?
grammar.explanation: The text says "I'll come unless I'm tired" — meaning won't come if tired.

units.title: Vida real condicional
units.real_life_context: Você combina condicionais variadas pra discutir vida real.

grammar.sentence: If I _____ time, I'll exercise.
grammar.explanation: If + present.

grammar.sentence: I _____ call you if it rains.
grammar.explanation: Consequência futura: will.

grammar.sentence: We'll travel _____ we save money.
grammar.explanation: "If we save" — condição positiva.

grammar.sentence: I'll come _____ I'm sick.
grammar.explanation: "Unless I'm sick" = a menos que esteja doente.

grammar.sentence: If she _____ early, we'll have time.
grammar.explanation: 3ª pessoa: arrives.

grammar.sentence: I'll go to the gym _____ I'm too tired.
grammar.explanation: Unless = if not.

grammar.sentence: What _____ you do if it rains?
grammar.explanation: "What will you do?" — WH futuro.

grammar.sentence: If it will rain, I'll stay home.
grammar.answer: If it rains, I'll stay home.
grammar.explanation: "If + present", não will.

grammar.sentence: I will come unless it doesn't rain.
grammar.explanation: Unless + presente afirmativo. Sem "unless + not".

grammar.passage: If it's sunny tomorrow, I'll go to the beach. If it rains, I'll stay home. I'll meet my friend unless she cancels.
grammar.question: When won't the speaker meet the friend?
grammar.explanation: The text says "unless she cancels" — meaning won't meet if she does.
